subject.title: [voice-call] OpenAI realtime: audio clipping / breaking inside words during first ~30s of outbound calls (Twilio mulaw output)

question: Should maintainers require a fresh Twilio/OpenAI live repro with redacted audio or level/queue logs before any codec, gain, provider-format, or pacing change for this issue?
rationale: The reporter's 2026.5.20 reproduction is credible, but source comparison shows the suspected codec format was already present there and current main has only adjacent fixes without direct clipping proof.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-run or reporter-provided current-main Twilio/OpenAI call artifact before selecting the fix layer.

options.title: Land diagnostic instrumentation only
options.body: Accept a narrow logging/probe change that records output peaks, queue depth, and backpressure without changing audio behavior.

options.title: Close after external proof
options.body: Close only if maintainers already have current-release live call evidence showing the first-30-second clipping no longer reproduces.

recommendation.title: Require live repro first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-run or reporter-provided current-main Twilio/OpenAI call artifact before selecting the fix layer.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal for the suspected codec/resampler boundary is steipete's merged work in src/talk/audio-codec.ts.
